nodes.text: With all the election news/drama in the US and a ton of other countries, it may have slipped the media's notice that there is a new pandemic that is making the coronavirus look like the common cold. Human Metapneumovirus or HMPV. No specific HMPV antiviral therapy and no vaccine.
